# Tools & Frameworks {#sec-tooling}

> **Stub.** The applied layer — what practitioners actually deploy. To catalog (with what
> each does, where it sits in the [attack surface](../foundations/security-foundations.qmd),
> and maturity):
>
> - **Guardrails / runtime** — NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard [@inan2023llamaguard],
>   ShieldGemma, Guardrails AI, Constitutional Classifiers [@sharma2025constitutional],
>   interface firewalls [@huang2025firewalls].
> - **Evaluation harnesses** — Inspect (UK AISI), AgentDojo [@debenedetti2024agentdojo],
>   Agent Security Bench [@zhang2024asb], HELM, lm-evaluation-harness.
> - **Red-teaming / attack** — garak, PyRIT, Giskard.
> - **Interpretability** — TransformerLens, Gemma Scope SAEs [@lieberum2024gemmascope].
> - **Provenance / content authenticity** — C2PA, watermarking toolkits.
>
> Selection criteria, integration patterns, and a maturity rating per tool to follow.
